references.text: Jotham's curse against Abimelech and the men of Shechem, now coming to fulfillment
God brought the violence done to Jerubbaal's sons back upon the perpetrators
Evil returns to the head of the evildoer, a principle of retribution
A curse that truly comes to fulfillment through God's judgment
The wickedness of the evil one returns upon his own head
Whoever digs a pit for others falls into it themselves - the principle of retribution
As you have done, so shall it be done to you - your deeds will return upon your own head
